name: Archer's Armor
description: Archer's Armor, favored by humble warriors, is cheap to make and still stops a blade.

name: Arctic Fox Armor
description: If you want to survive the icy tundra in style, the Arctic Fox Armor is the best choice this season.

name: Battle Robe
description: The Battle Robe is worn by the distinguished Illager Evokers of the Arch-Illager's court.

name: Beehive Armor
description: The Beehive Armor hums with the focused power of countless bees.

effects.label: chance to summon a bee when hit (max

properties: 30% chance to summon a bee when hit (max 3)

name: Beenest Armor
description: There always seems to be a slight buzz around the Beenest Armor. Or maybe the buzz is coming from within?

effects.label: chance to summon a bee when hit (max

properties: 30% chance to summon a bee when hit (max 3)

name: Black Spot Armor
description: This decaying armor has an unsettling presence, as if observing you.
properties: Reset Artifact Cooldown on potion use

name: Black Wolf Armor
description: The wolf who strikes from the shadows lives to tell the tale.

name: Cauldron Armor
description: The Cauldron Armor was created with camouflage in mind, but what it lacks in stealth it makes up for in bubbly charm.

name: Cave Crawler
description: The Cave Crawler armor has been passed down through generations of brave spelunkers and miners.

name: Champion's Armor
description: Granted to the champions of the Overworld by the free villagers as a token of their thanks for many years of protection and assistance. The mark of a true hero.

name: Climbing Gear
description: This sturdy Climbing Gear is perfect for braving the blistering cold of the icy mountain face.

name: Cloaked Skull
description: Shroud your scary skeletal form with a creepy cloak, still spooky!
properties: Briefly gain Ghost Form when rolling

name: Dark Armor
description: Dark Armor, made in the blackest depths of the Fiery Forge, is worn by the Illager royal guard.

name: Ember Robe
description: The Ember Robe was created by Illager Evokers to distinguish themselves from the common guard.

name: Emerald Gear
description: As you wear the Emerald Gear during your adventures, it calls other emeralds to you as if by chance.
properties: Chance to spawn emeralds when exploring.

name: Entertainer's Garb
description: Defensive? Sure. Fabulous? ABSOLUTELY.

name: Evocation Robe
description: Potent magical runes are weaved into the fabric of these robes, their origins and true powers are shrouded in mystery.

name: Fox Armor
description: Ancient Villager tribes created this armor to honor the fox, who is a great and agile warrior.

name: Frost Armor
description: This legendary armor, forged from ice that never melts, makes the wearer feel as if they are one with winter.

name: Frost Bite
description: Frost Bite remembers the icy winds which once flowed beneath the wings of mighty Phantoms.

name: Full Metal Armor
description: Full Metal Armor is destined for the great defenders of the Overworld.

name: Ghost Kindler
description: Strange flames follow the shifting form of those who wear the Ghost Kindler armor.
properties: Briefly gain Ghost Form when rolling

name: Ghostly Armor
description: Those who wear Ghostly Armor may feel their bodies briefly disconnect from the physical world, but are quickly snapped back to reality.
properties: Briefly gain Ghost Form when rolling

name: Gilded Glory
description: Even death itself has to pause and admire the charms of the legendary Gilded Glory armor.
properties: Chance to spawn emeralds when exploring
Can spend emeralds to cheat death

name: Glow Squid Armor
description: Those who hunt elusive glow squids wear this armor to blend in with their beautiful prey.
properties: Release an ink cloud when rolling

name: Goat Gear
description: Made from the pelts of Mountain Goats, you'll feel like skipping from peak to peak in this Goat Gear.

name: Golden Piglin Armor
description: The Golden Piglin Armor combines a piglin's two favorite things: not dying and gold.
properties: Can get consumable on potion use
Reset Artifact Cooldown on potion use

name: Grim Armor
description: Grim Armor invokes a sense of dread for the one who wears it and to those who face it in battle.

name: Guard's Armor
description: Cheap armor made in bulk, the Guard's Armor is a common sight in the villages of the Overworld.

name: Hero's Armor
description: Only given to the highest caliber of heroes, the Hero's Armor is a precious gift from the Villagers.

name: Highland Armor
description: A wise armorer made this armor with care.

name: Hungriest Horror
description: Donning this armor brings great power, but along with that power comes a hunger that can never be satisfied...

name: Hungry Horror
description: When you wear this cloak, the sounds of screams fill the air. But are the screams yours, or your enemies'?

name: Hunter's Armor
description: Hunter's Armor may not be the fanciest gear around, but it will stop a blade.

name: Living Vines Armor
description: This armor is made from the living vines of a plant which grows only on battlefields.
properties: Traps and poisons nearby mobs when rolling

name: Mercenary Armor
description: Mercenary Armor, favored by those looking to save some coin, lacks flair but gets the job done.

name: Mystery Armor
description: Some blacksmiths see the design influence of Iron Golems in this property-shifting armor.

name: Nimble Turtle Armor
description: This armor is made from the dense (but surprisingly light) shells of turtles who lived at crushing depths.

name: Ocelot Armor
description: You feel a rush of pure adrenaline surge through your body when you wear this Ocelot's pelt.

name: Opulent Armor
description: Opulent Armor, originally designed more for show than for combat, thrives in the presence of Emeralds.
properties: Chance to spawn emeralds when exploring

name: Phantom Armor
description: This armor, crafted from the bones of Phantoms, is a terrifying sight on the battlefield.

name: Piglin Armor
description: Wearing this Piglin Armor is almost enough to make one feel at home in the Nether. Almost.
properties: Reset Artifact Cooldown on potion use

name: Plate Armor
description: Plate armor turns the average soldier into a fortress but comes with reduced mobility.

name: Reinforced Mail
description: Mostly worn by casual adventurers, Reinforced Mail is a common sight throughout the land.

name: Renegade Armor
description: Renegade Armor made a fine payment for mercenaries hired to protect the villages against Illagers.

name: Root Rot Armor
description: Twisted roots form this aberrant armor, its malevolent nature evident.
properties: Reset Artifact Cooldown on potion use

name: Rugged Climbing Gear
description: Take on the worst that nature can throw at you in this rugged armor.

name: Scale Mail
description: This armor, crafted near the shores of a great sea, was inspired by the scales of fish.

name: Shadow Walker
description: The legendary black Ocelot was as graceful as it was deadly. When you wear its pelt, you feel like your enemies are left chasing your shadow.

name: Shulker Armor
description: Shulker Armor rivals even the toughest steel plate.

name: Snow Armor
description: A suit of armor that was tempered in snowmelt, protecting the wearer from the harsh cold of the tundra.

name: Soul Robe
description: In a particular light, the souls woven into the cloth of the Soul Robe shimmer with power.

name: Souldancer Robe
description: The Souldancer Robe comes alive in the light, as if the souls within are dancing for all eternity.

name: Spelunker Armor
description: The Spelunker Armor is worn by those who brave the darkest depths of the Overworld.

name: Spider Armor
description: Spider Armor, created by master thieves, is inspired by the agile talents of the Spider.

name: Splendid Robe
description: The distinguished Splendid Robe is worn by the hardened Illager warriors who protect the Arch-Illager.

name: Sprout Armor
description: The dark vines of the Sprout Armor continue to grow even in complete darkness.
properties: Traps and poisons nearby mobs when rolling

name: Squid Armor
description: It was easy to make this jet-black armor look cool. The hard part was securing the ink sacs.
properties: Release an ink cloud when rolling

name: Stalwart Armor
description: This reliable armor is sturdy enough to be passed down for generations.

name: Sturdy Shulker Armor
description: They say the best defense is a good offense, but good luck breaking through this bulwark.
properties: Fire shulker projectiles at nearby enemies

name: Sweet Tooth
description: This armor may look like a piece of cake to your enemies, but it is surprisingly durable in battle. Must be the fondant.

name: Teleportation Robes
description: The Teleportation Robes were made by those who devoted their lives to studying the enigmas of the End.

name: The Spooky Gourdian
description: Those who wear the mantle of The Spooky Gourdian become the legendary terror of Pumpkin Pastures!

name: The Troubadour
description: Why leave your adoring fans wanting more when you can wow them with this inspirational outfit?

name: Thief Armor
description: This armor is light, nimble, and smells faintly of sulfur.

name: Titan's Shroud
description: The inspiring tales of the Titan's Shroud armor have passed through Pumpkin Pastures for generations.

name: Turtle Armor
description: The Turtle Armor is inspired by the hardy and protective shell of the humble turtle.

name: Unstable Robes
description: This Enderobe sparks with static as you sashay across the battlefield.

name: Verdant Robe
description: Those who don the Verdant Robe soon find that they can commune with more souls than ever before.

name: Wither Armor
description: Wither Armor, crafted with the parts of slain enemies, was made to terrify the wearer's enemies.

name: Wolf Armor
description: Many warriors wear the heads of wolves into battle to strike fear into the hearts of their enemies.
